prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Os Santos examinam-se à luz das perfeições de Deus, e fazem penitência.

meta.face: A Copt of about ninety with deep-brown, sun-dark skin and a small, ELFIN, TRIANGULAR face — a BROAD, BULGING, BALD forehead and wide temples tapering sharply to a SMALL, POINTED chin; LARGE, prominent ears; small, BRIGHT, black eyes deep in a web of laughter lines; a small, sharp, HOOKED nose; a WIDE, thin-lipped mouth in a broad, cheerful smile; a SHORT, thin, wispy white beard that leaves the pointed chin's shape clear; the gaze merry and piercing, toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the Catalan engraving on Wikipedia shows a generic hooded hermit. The book stresses his 'holy joy and cheerfulness', his fifty years in his cell on a cliff, and the window through which he spoke and blessed oil for the sick; its engraving shows him blessing at the window. Lycopolis is Asyut on the Nile (Wikipedia). The small, merry, triangular old face is our choice, apart from the set's long-bearded desert fathers.
